name: ZPay
tagline: A buy-now-pay-later app for Uzbekistan: installments, partner stores and bonus Z-coins
role: Mobile app development by the Softwhere team

scenes.title: Phone sign-up with SMS code
scenes.body: Register, log in or skip to browse; the number is masked as you type and confirmed with a 4-digit code.

scenes.title: Passport details, face photo and PIN
scenes.body: Identification takes passport data and a guided face photo; a 4-digit PIN can be paired with Face ID.

scenes.title: Your limit and Z-coins at a glance
scenes.body: Current limit, Z-coin bonuses, QR scanner and recent charges up front; cards are added with a design picker.

scenes.title: Contracts and payment plans
scenes.body: Each contract shows its term, status and monthly payment schedule, with early repayment from a saved card.

scenes.title: Partner stores and bonus spending
scenes.body: Partner offers by category with monthly prices; saved bonuses pay for mobile, internet, utilities and more.
